_comment: Measured, not aspirational. Regenerate with `make eval-real` and commit the new file in the same PR as the change that moved it. Never hand-edit a score.
_why_per_provider: Execution accuracy is a property of the model as much as the pipeline, so one blended number would be meaningless. The gate compares the active provider against its own baseline; swapping providers is a deliberate act that needs its own measurement, not a silent pass or fail.
_tolerance_rationale: One answerable case is worth 1/21 = 0.0476. A tolerance below that fires on a single case flipping, which is noise, not regression; 0.05 absorbs exactly one case and blocks two (0.0952). Sampling variance is not the driver - temperature is 0.0 - so the tolerance is sized by set granularity. If the set grows to 50 answerable cases, one case becomes 0.02 and this should tighten.

groq/llama-3.3-70b-versatile._note: The deployed provider. Measured through the same decorator stack production uses - the free tier rate-limits a back-to-back 26-case run, and RetryingProvider honours Retry-After.
groq/llama-3.3-70b-versatile._refusal_note: 0.80 -> 1.00 after the deterministic scope gate (2026-08-14). Execution accuracy was unchanged at 0.8095, which is the check that matters: the gate caught the miss without refusing anything answerable.

ollama/qwen2.5:7b-instruct._note: Self-hosted 7B. Not the deployed provider; kept so the Ollama path stays gated.
ollama/qwen2.5:7b-instruct._stale: Measured BEFORE the scope gate. Its one refusal miss was 'Show me the best countries' - an ambiguity case the gate does not catch - so this number is NOT assumed to have improved. Re-measure before quoting it.
